sources.entry: Frame Player - Video player built on libmpv with seekbar previews, subtitle search matched to the release, torrent streaming, casting to Chromecast and DLNA televisions, and watching together in sync.

summary.one_liner: Frame Player is a desktop video player built on Tauri 2 and libmpv that plays local files, links and magnet torrents, with casting to TVs, subtitle search, and synced watch-together rooms.
summary.what_it_does: Plays local files, direct stream URLs, anything yt-dlp resolves, and magnet links streamed while they download, with the interface drawn as HTML over a native mpv view. The seekbar shows thumbnails of the exact frame under the cursor, plus chapter names and a skip button for intros and credits. Subtitles are searched on OpenSubtitles by file hash with a title fallback, and downloads are saved beside the video. Casting works over Google Cast and DLNA, and on macOS also AirPlay, with the window acting as a remote while the TV plays. A watch-together mode syncs position, pauses and speed between players through a Go relay, with the media itself fetched by each player separately. A built-in catalog can browse TMDB metadata and pick releases from a user-supplied Torznab server.
use_cases: watch a torrent while it downloads
cast a local video to a Chromecast or DLNA TV
watch a film in sync with a friend remotely
find and download subtitles matched to a video file
play video files with HDR and Dolby Vision
mini always-on-top video window on macOS
notable: Watch-together rooms sync a shared timeline with a six-character code; media never passes through the relay
Seekbar previews decode the exact frame under the cursor rather than the preceding keyframe
Casting picks per device and per file whether to send the original or remux, with video stream-copied
Remembered audio and subtitle tracks are matched by language, title, codec and forced flag rather than track number
Hotkeys bind to physical keys and can all be reassigned
caveats: Windows installer is not code-signed, so SmartScreen warns on first launch
AirPlay works only on macOS, and the macOS libmpv must be fetched or rebuilt with a patch for --wid embedding
Prebuilt packages target Windows x64/ARM64 and macOS on Apple Silicon only; no Intel macOS build is produced
